heading: Repealed. Pub. L. 96–465, title II, § 2205(1), Oct. 17, 1980, 94 Stat. 2159

notes.text: Section, act Aug. 13, 1946, ch. 957, title VI, § 671, 60 Stat. 1017, related to separation from service of consular agents.
